data.title: Students take home 4 medals
data.description: Thai students have won four medals at International Olympiad in Informatics (IOI) 2026 in Uzbekistan, the Promotion of Teaching Science and Technology (IPST) says.

data.title: Cabinet nod gets Hat Yai monorail on track
data.description: The Mass Rapid Transit Authority of Thailand (MRTA) is set to advance Songkhla province’s Hat Yai monorail project after the cabinet approved its authority to operate rail services in the province.

data.title: Falling tree injures 4 Spaniards at Ayutthaya historical park
data.description: PHRA NAKHON SI AYUTTHAYA - A large flame tree collapsed in the grounds of historical Wat Phra Si Sanphet temple on Sunday, injuring four Spanish tourists - one seriously.

data.title: 'Wanted' Chinese fraudster arrested in Pattaya
data.description: PATTAYA - Police have arrested a 30-year-old Chinese man wanted by authorities in China for alleged fraud and money laundering, and he will be extradited to his homeland.

data.title: Police stakeout illegal racers with a roadside BBQ
data.description: SAMUT PRAKAN - Undercover police work often involves disguises, surveillance and patience. In Bang Phli on Saturday night, it also involved a <i>moo krata</i> grill.

data.title: Vast peat fire burning in major swamp forest
data.description: NAKHON SI THAMMARAT - A vast fire is still burning in the Phru Khuan Khreng peat swamp forest in this southern province, defying firefighters' efforts three days after it erupted.

data.title: Ministry acts to end dispute between Israelis and Samui zoo owner
data.description: The Interior Ministry will take action to end the dispute between the owner of an exotic animal zoo on Koh Samui and an Israeli family who were refused entry, Deputy Interior Minister Polapee Suwunchwee said on Sunday.

data.title: North, Northeast forecast is for heavy rain, flood risk
data.description: Heavy to very heavy rain is expected across parts of northern and northeastern Thailand rom Tuesday into Friday, raising the risk of flash floods and forest runoff in vulnerable areas.

data.title: Accomplice gets 5 years over MP car shooting
data.description: The Narathiwat provincial court sentenced a man to five years in prison for his role in an attempted murder case involving Prachachat Party MP Kamolsak Leewamoh.

data.title: Man gets 5 years over shooting MP
data.description: The Narathiwat provincial court sentenced a man to five years in prison for his role in an attempted murder case involving Prachachat Party MP Kamolsak Leewamoh.

data.title: Laos deports 23 gamblers
data.description: NONG KHAI: Twenty-three Thai nationals were deported from Laos on Friday following a crackdown on online gambling networks by Lao authorities, police said on Saturday.

data.title: Public warned on school threats
data.description: <p>The Department of Mental Health has warned against threatening posts targeting schools, urging the public to follow its "2 No, 1 Join" principle: do not share, do not imitate, and report suspicious clues.</p>

data.title: Govt backs new maritime talks chair
data.description: <p>Thailand has welcomed the appointment of Katrina Cooper, Australia's Special Envoy for Greater Sunrise in the Timor Sea, as chair of the Conciliation Commission under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS), addressing the maritime dispute between Thailand and Cambodia.</p>

data.title: Govt tightens net on scammers
data.description: <p>The government will intensify efforts to combat online crime from "source to destination", targeting mule accounts and SIM cards, money trails, digital platforms and infrastructure used by criminals, as well as call-centre gangs and transnational crime networks, Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said.</p>

data.title: Ex-drug kingpin pardoned
data.description: Former drug kingpin Laota Saenlee, 86, has been released from Bang Kwang Central Prison after receiving a royal pardon under a decree issued to mark Her Majesty the Queen's 4th-cycle birthday anniversary.

data.title: Kingdom seeks relief from US tariffs; military leverage denied
data.description: <p>The government is preparing to hold talks with the United States over technical details on tariffs late this month, deputy government spokeswoman Lalida Persvivatana said, while dismissing reports Thailand may use military cooperation as leverage.</p>

data.title: PP chief renews call for better oversight
data.description: <p>Opposition leader Natthaphong Ruengpanyawut has renewed his criticism of the political system, saying that weak checks and balances, along with a constitution that allows flawed mechanisms to persist, are at the root of many problems.</p>

data.title: EC urged to bare facts in probe
data.description: <p>The Election Commission (EC) should disclose details of an investigation into alleged money transfers to an official linked to a probe into suspected Senate election fraud, says People's Party (PP) list-MP Parit Wacharasindhu.</p>

data.title: Family questions YouTuber's death certificate
data.description: <p>The family of Thai travel YouTuber Hlun Solo is seeking a clear explanation after a death certificate issued by Georgian authorities failed to state the cause of his demise.</p>

data.title: BMA unveils new city blueprint
data.description: <p>The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) is set to implement a 261-item framework, working with experts to promote city development.</p>

data.title: Govt urged to boost food resilience
data.description: <p>Thailand should use the disruption caused by the Middle East crisis to strengthen the resilience of its agricultural sector against future global shocks, the International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD) says.</p>

data.title: Thailand seeks EAEU free trade deal
data.description: <p>Talks on a free trade agreement (FTA) between Thailand and the Eurasian Economic Union (EAEU) hopefully will begin soon, helping expand trade with the bloc, says Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow.</p>

data.title: Deputy PM maps out plans for growth
data.description: <p>Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas has urged greater investment in basic infrastructure to propel Thailand into a new economic era.</p>

data.title: All on board safe after longtail boat capsizes off Krabi
data.description: Ten tourists, a guide and a boat skipper were all safely rescued after a longtail boat capsized off Laem Hang Nak in Krabi province on Saturday.
